CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS  Tuesday, April 4, 2023
FINANCE COMMITTEE  Special Meeting, 5:30 PM
MINUTES

  Maria Teresa Del Rio,  Ernesto Marquez,City Manager
Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
  Mayor  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director

  MINUTES
CALL TO ORDER

The Finance Committee meeting was called to order on Tuesday, April 4, 2023, at 5:54
PM.

ROLL CALL
PRESENT

  Maria Teresa Del Rio, Mayor
  Victor Farfan, Mayor Pro Tem
  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager
  Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director
PUBLIC COMMENTS - GENERAL OR ITEMS ON OR OFF THE AGENDA

There were no Public Comments.

DISCUSSION ITEM(S)
 1.  Budget Workshop.

  Ernesto Marquez, City Manager, and Linda Hollinsworth, Finance Director,
  presented information on the Fiscal Year 22-23 Budget and Proposed Budget for
  Fiscal Years 23-24 and 24-25.

  Committee discussed the city parade, city facilities maintenance, underground
  utilities, and commercial façade program.

NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business Items.

ADJOURNMENT

The Finance Committee meeting was adjourned at 6:19 PM.
